applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Miscellaneous) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks must note the deletion of Sub-section D of Chapter IV regarding deferment of option premium.
answer.action_quote: Sub-section D of Chapter IV (Paragraph 38) shall be deleted.

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from April 1, 2027.
